what: Stage 1 of the survival measurement-validity study (plan docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-29-survival-measurement-validity-study.md, D-117). Rules fixed and committed BEFORE any lambda value was computed. Post hoc and exploratory: the correlations were already used by N6, N9 and D-104.
population: per language, features with FP firing_rate > 0.001 (Duan's rule, phase1_run.survival_summary)
reproduction_control: per-language survived_>0.9_pct and median_corr recomputed from survival.pt must equal reports/phase1/mask/eq/per_language.csv (legacy) and the a/b columns of reports/gptq_extension/results/stage1/stage1_paired_per_language.csv (b = legacy, a = arm) within 1e-6; otherwise stop and report
lambda: lambda = log(1/r^2 - 1) with r clipped to [0.001, 1 - 1e-6]; counts of clipped values reported per cell; r <= 0.001 includes negative and zero correlations

H1.statistic: per language: Spearman(lambda_arm, lambda_legacy) over the language's active features, and the geometric-mean slope sd(lambda_arm)/sd(lambda_legacy) over features with neither value clipped
H1.rule: met for an (arm, width) if the median over 27 languages of Spearman >= 0.8 AND the median slope lies in [0.8, 1.25]; H1 overall met if met in all four (matched RTN, GPTQ) x (INT6, INT4) cells

H2.statistic: shift delta(arm, width) = median over all active (language, feature) pairs of (lambda_arm - lambda_legacy); predicted survival per language = share of (lambda_legacy + delta) < -1.44985; observed = arm's survival share; MAE over 27 languages in percentage points; reference: the no-shift prediction (legacy share)
H2.rule: met for an (arm, width) if MAE <= 2.0 points; H2 overall met if met in all four cells; the no-shift MAE is reported beside it

H3_lambda_half.statistic: per language: Spearman(lambda, log10 FP max_activation) over active features; median over languages; also the per-language R^2 of OLS lambda ~ log10 max_activation + log10 mean_activation + log10 firing_rate (unclipped features)
H3_lambda_half.rule: the lambda half of plan H3 is met for a cell if |median Spearman| > 0.5; the nu half needs Stage 2

tier.statistic: per language outcome = MINUS the median lambda over active features (log signal-to-noise, higher = better, the same direction as survival, so the one-sided test of phase1_analysis.freedman_lane_tier_test keeps its meaning: higher tier, better); script-family dummies, 10,000 permutations, seed 0; without and with the N9 covariate (log10 median max_activation, phase1_language_level.language_activation_scale)
tier.rule: descriptive only; slope and p per (arm, width) without and with the scale covariate; no equivalence claim from a large p
